blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Former president Rodrigo Duterte is expected to attend the International Criminal Court (ICC) Trial Chamber III’s fourth status conference in his crimes against humanity case on Tuesday. Duterte has yet to waive his right to attend the hearing as granted by the chamber, which is why he is expected to appear before the […]...
